standard_prerequisites.name: Flatness is preserved by base change and by localisation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-flat-base-change} and Algebra, Lemma \ref{algebra-lemma-flat-localization}, cited at proof lines 4100-4102
standard_prerequisites.use: Give flatness of the localisation at the prime of the base change.

core_obligations: Take a prime of the base changed algebra over the extended ideal and identify the prime below it (proof lines 4092-4097).
Verify that the prime below contains the image of the ideal, so flatness holds there (proof lines 4097-4099).
Identify the localisation as a localisation of the base change of the flat localised module (proof lines 4099-4100).
Conclude flatness by stability under base change and localisation (proof lines 4100-4102).
proof_roadmap: The primes and the hypothesis (proof lines 4092-4099).
Localisation as a base changed localisation (proof lines 4099-4100).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the condition that a module be flat over the base at all primes containing the image of an ideal is preserved by base change, with the ideal extended correspondingly. The proof takes a prime of the base changed algebra containing the extended ideal, notes that the prime of the algebra below it contains the image of the ideal so that flatness holds there by hypothesis, observes that the localisation at the chosen prime is a localisation of the base change of that flat localised module, and derives flatness from stability of flatness under base change and localisation.
